limitations: This GO admits one measurement only. Actual cause controls, old and holdout quality gates, resource peaks and preservation remain unmeasured until that run completes.

The holdout is new-position validation on previously frozen faces. It is not face-disjoint validation, exhaustive full-surface evidence, complete semantic segmentation or arbitrary-viewer qualification.

Exact source-sampled corner agreement is expected from the construction. Interior agreement remains a separate measured requirement because source-spatial field interpolation and triangle interpolation in linear colour are different operations.
